# Vipul Singh — App Promo Videos

> Vipul Singh makes premium promo and intro videos for mobile apps (iOS and Android): real app footage in animated 3D phone mockups, with motion graphics, kinetic text, voiceover, music and captions. Every video is delivered in both 9:16 (vertical) and 16:9 (horizontal), 48 hours after the client picks a script. Prices start at $39.

Website: https://vipul-singh.netlify.app/

## Service

- What: app promo videos and app intro videos, also called device mockup videos or motion-graphics app showcases.
- For: mobile app developers, indie developers, startups and app publishers who need a video for their App Store or Google Play listing, Google App Campaigns, Meta/Instagram ads, Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, YouTube, a website or a launch.
- Platforms: iOS and Android apps; one video works for both stores. Casual and simple games too.
- No source code needed: an App Store / Google Play link, a TestFlight or closed-testing invite, or an APK is enough. Unreleased apps are fine, and an NDA is available.
- Clients: worldwide. Voiceover in English, Hindi and other languages.

## Pricing (USD)

- Promo video, 15–30 seconds: $39
- Intro video, 30–60 seconds: $69
- Launch bundle (promo + intro, 4 files): $99
- Every package: 9:16 + 16:9, 3 script options before production, AI voiceover (male or female), music made for the video, animated captions, blurring of personal data on screen, a branded end card, and 2 revision rounds.
- Add-ons: extra language version $19, 24-hour rush delivery $29, extra revision round $10.
- Payment: 50% to start, 50% on delivery, by PayPal, Wise, card or UPI.

## Delivery

- 48 hours after the client chooses a script (launch bundle: 3–4 days).
- The client owns the final videos and can use them anywhere, including paid ads.

## Compared with alternatives

- Doing it yourself: 2–3 weeks, plus editing, motion-design and audio skills.
- Typical agency: 2–4 weeks and $1,000+.
- Vipul Singh: 48 hours, from $39, voiceover, music and both formats included.
